title: D-1/D-2 source resolver boundary: scoped MCP intents and permanent retirement state

filesChanged.change: MODIFIED: HarnessSourceState gains optional `retired?: HarnessRetiredSources` (Batch 21 type, imported from ../targets/harness-target.port); absent = nothing retired so static resolvers/spec fakes stay valid. mcpIntents doc now states global + this workspace's records only (D-1).

MODIFIED: resolve(ws) reads `retired` once before the plugin reader and carries it on every state (sync success, reader null/throws, sync read failure, effective success, policy-unknown, effective failure). New readRetiredSources(): skillSourceRoots = <pluginsRoot>/<rootId> for each rootId of ~/.ptah/plugins/SKILLS_SH_RETIRED_FILE parsed with parseSkillsShRetiredRegistry (non-basename ids dropped, sorted; absent/unparseable/malformed -> []); mcpServerKeys = McpIntentStore.listRetired() keys. New exported defaultSkillsShPluginsRoot(homeDir) and an optional 5th constructor param skillsShPluginsRoot (defaults to it; hosts unchanged). readMcpIntents keeps the Batch 18 listFor(ws ?? '') call, documented as canonical-root, global-only when unscoped. No list() shim; no second source-port writer.

MODIFIED: new describe 'workspace scope and retirement': install in A absent from B's resolved mcpIntents AND from HarnessManifestBuilder.build(stateB).mcp (present for A); global ∪ local target merge (A: claude+codex, B: claude, unscoped: claude); sub-directory resolves its canonical root's records; retired sources equal on all 7 resolution paths (incl. read-failure and policy-unknown), with '..' and 'nested/escape' ids dropped and v1 server never desired; absent/non-JSON/wrong-version registry retires no skill root; both registries re-read each pass.

behaviour.mcpScope: resolve(ws).mcpIntents = McpIntentStore.listFor(ws): global targets ∪ the canonical workspace's targets; unscoped resolve = global only, never every workspace.
behaviour.retired: resolve(ws).retired: HarnessRetiredSources = { skillSourceRoots: absolute '<~/.ptah/plugins>/<rootId>' sorted, mcpServerKeys: retired v1 keys sorted }, on every resolution. Threading into reconcile options/planner stays Batch 22+ work per batch-21 contract.portInputs.

decisions.decision: HarnessSourceState.retired is optional (absent = nothing retired); PluginConfigSourceResolver always sets it.
options: optional field filled by the one producer
decisions.evidence: harness-source.port.ts makes mcpIntents/disabledAgentIds/agentModels optional so createStaticSourceResolver and spec fakes (reconciler/*.spec.ts, health/harness-destination-scanner.spec.ts) stay assignable; a required field would force edits outside this batch.

decisions.decision: The skills.sh plugins root is an optional 5th resolver constructor param defaulting to defaultSkillsShPluginsRoot() = ~/.ptah/plugins; HarnessSourceLayout is unchanged.
decisions.evidence: Hosts (apps/ptah-electron, apps/ptah-extension-vscode phase-2-libraries.ts, cli-engine container.ts) call createPluginConfigSourceResolver without a layout and with the default McpIntentStore at the home path; a param with a home default needs no host change, matching the mcpIntents default.

decisions.decision: Registry root ids that are not a plain basename ('.', '..', anything with a separator) are dropped.
decisions.evidence: Batch 21 contract: skillSourceRoots item id = skillsShRetiredItemId(basename(root)); a non-basename id would not round-trip and could name a directory outside ~/.ptah/plugins.

decisions.decision: An absent, unparseable or malformed retired registry retires no skill root.
decisions.evidence: parseSkillsShRetiredRegistry contract: 'reader decides (absent file = nothing retired)'. IHarnessSourceResolver must never throw. Without a retired mark, a copy is still manifest-owned and removed only under the ordinary hash rule, so this keeps files rather than deleting them.

decisions.decision: mcpServerKeys lists every retired v1 key, including keys that were recorded again in v2.
decisions.evidence: The planner consults it only for removals (HarnessPlanRemove.retiredItemId, batch-21 contract.portInputs). An active key is desired and never removed for its active targets; a copy of the same key on a target that is no longer desired is a v1 leftover and should go through the proof policy. mcp-intent-store.ts record() keeps the retired entry beside an active one by design.

coordinatorFix.change: Root-id filter also drops the empty id: join(pluginsRoot, "") is the plugins root itself. Spec fixture adds an empty key.
